newsitem.title: BELARUS: MAN, Mercedes in talks with Belarus truckmaker.
newsitem.headline: MAN, Mercedes in talks with Belarus truckmaker.

text.p: German automakers MAN Nutzfahrzeuge AG and Mercedes-Benz AG have been negotiating separately to help modernise truckmaker Minsk Avtomobilny Zavod (MAZ) of Belarus, the country's Minister of Foreign Economic Relations Mikhail Marinich said.

"We are discussing the topic of reconstruction of MAZ with MAN and Mercedes," Marinich said. "At this point, MAN is closer to coming here than Mercedes. We think we will know in October who will come for sure."

He did not elaborate on the negotiations, but newspapers in Belarus and Russia have speculated that MAN wants to sell truck cabs and engines to MAZ. The sales could lead to joint assembly of the parts in Belarus, according to local news reports.

MAZ, which under communism bought MAN engines, specialises in producing truck tractors for international transport. It needs modern engines to sell to truck companies that must meet increasingly tough fuel emission standards in western Europe.
MAZ already has been working with another Germany company since the early 1990s, assembling buses based on Neoplan models from Gottlob Auwarter Gmbh and Co of Stuttgart.
